# PRELIMINARY FUNCTIONS #######################################################
library(benchmarkme)

# Load packages ---------------------------------------------------------------

if (!requireNamespace("sensobol", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("sensobol")
sensobol::load_packages(c("here", "data.table", "ggplot2", "cowplot", "scales",
                          "readxl", "jsonlite", "sf", "rnaturalearth",
                          "rnaturalearthdata", "ggrepel"))

# Source all .R files in the "functions" folder -------------------------------

r_functions <- list.files(path = here("functions"),
                          pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)
invisible(lapply(r_functions, source))
```

```{r load-data, dependson="preliminary"}
# LOAD DATA ###################################################################

out <- here("datasets", "output")
arm_dir <- file.path(out, "arm"); chk_dir <- file.path(out, "checkpoint")
col_irr <- "#b2182b"; col_leg <- "#2166ac"

# Corpus metadata --------------------------------------------------------------

dt <- load_coded_corpus_fun()
dt[, domain_short := fcase(
  main_category == "Crop knowledge and management", "Crop",
  main_category == "Irrigation practices and communal water management", "Irrigation",
  main_category == "Soil and moisture management", "Soil & moisture",
  main_category == "Weather and climate conditions", "Weather & climate")]

# Rule-only draws, deepseek leg on v4 ------------------------------------------

read_arm <- function(f) as.data.table(utils::read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                                                      encoding = "UTF-8"))
parse_json_field <- function(txt, field) {
  vapply(txt, function(t) {
    if (is.na(t) || t == "") return(NA_character_)
    o <- tryCatch(fromJSON(t), error = function(e) NULL)
    v <- o[[field]]
    if (is.null(v)) NA_character_ else as.character(v)
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
bin_files <- c(standard = file.path(chk_dir, "chk_standard_raw_all.csv"),
               short = file.path(arm_dir, "arm_short_raw_all.csv"),
               strict = file.path(arm_dir, "arm_strict_raw_all.csv"))
bin <- rbindlist(lapply(names(bin_files), function(nm) {
  d <- read_arm(bin_files[[nm]])
  d[, legible := as.logical(parse_json_field(text, "efficiency_legible"))]
  d[, .(prompt = nm, provider, id_cite = sub("__s.*$", "", custom_id), legible)]
}))[!is.na(legible)]
v4 <- rbindlist(lapply(names(bin_files), function(nm) {
  d <- read_arm(file.path(out, sprintf("v4_ruleonly_%s_deepseek_raw_all.csv", nm)))
  d[, legible := as.logical(parse_json_field(text, "efficiency_legible"))]
  d[, .(prompt = nm, provider = "deepseek",
        id_cite = sub("__s.*$", "", custom_id), legible)]
}))[!is.na(legible)]
bin <- rbind(bin[provider != "deepseek"], v4)

# Per-draw function sets for the nine full-instrument arms ---------------------

funcs12 <- c("crop_production", "water_conservation", "soil_health",
             "risk_management", "groundwater_recharge",
             "microclimate_regulation", "biodiversity", "pest_control",
             "livestock", "medicinal_food", "social_cohesion",
             "recreation_wellbeing")
core2 <- c("crop_production", "water_conservation")
fun_lab <- c(crop_production = "Crop production",
             water_conservation = "Water conservation",
             soil_health = "Soil health maintenance", risk_management = "Risk management",
             social_cohesion = "Social cohesion", biodiversity = "Biodiversity conservation",
             groundwater_recharge = "Groundwater recharge",
             microclimate_regulation = "Microclimate regulation",
             pest_control = "Pest control", livestock = "Livestock husbandry",
             medicinal_food = "Wild food and medicine",
             recreation_wellbeing = "Recreation/wellbeing")

arm_file <- function(fam, ph) {
  if (fam == "anthropic" && ph == "standard")
    file.path(out, "coding_results_raw_analytical_anthropic.csv")
  else file.path(out, sprintf("coding_results_raw_attribution_%s_%s.csv", ph, fam))
}
families <- c("anthropic", "openai", "deepseek")
phrasings <- c("strict", "standard", "broad")
draws <- rbindlist(lapply(families, function(fam)
  rbindlist(lapply(phrasings, function(ph) {
    d <- read_arm(arm_file(fam, ph))[!duplicated(custom_id)]
    rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(d)), function(i) {
      o <- tryCatch(fromJSON(d$text[i]), error = function(e) NULL)
      fs <- if (is.null(o$functions)) character(0) else
        intersect(unlist(o$functions), funcs12)
      if (!length(fs)) return(NULL)
      data.table(family = fam, phrasing = ph,
                 id_cite = sub("__s.*$", "", d$custom_id[i]),
                 draw = d$custom_id[i], f = fs)
    }))
  }))))
vote_rules <- c(`any draw` = 0.2, majority = 0.6, unanimous = 1.0)
fam_lab <- c(anthropic = "Claude", openai = "GPT-5.4", deepseek = "DeepSeek-v4")
```

# Results 1: how much knowledge efficiency metrics can hold

```{r figS3-sobol-build, dependson="load-data"}
# FIGURE 1 PANELS #############################################################

sob_grid <- fread(file.path(out, "sobol_headline_grid.csv"))
sob_ind <- fread(file.path(out, "sobol_headline_indices.csv"))
sob_tot <- fread(file.path(out, "sobol_headline_totals.csv"))
sob_sum <- fread(file.path(out, "sobol_headline_summary.csv"))
anchor <- sob_sum[quantity == "anchor_full_instrument", value]
fac_lab <- c(community = "Community", domain = "Knowledge domain",
             model = "LLM family", prompt = "Prompt", vote = "Vote rule")

# Panel a: the share across specifications, split by vote rule ----------------

sob_grid[, vote := factor(vote, levels = c("any draw", "majority", "unanimous"),
                          labels = c("Any draw", "Majority", "Unanimous"))]
vote_labs <- c(expression(paste("Any draw (", "" >= 1, ~"of 5)")),
               expression(paste("Majority (", "" >= 3, ~"of 5)")),
               expression(paste("Unanimous (5 of 5)")))

plot_sob_a <- ggplot(sob_grid, aes(share, fill = vote)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01, boundary = 0, colour = NA, alpha = 0.5,
                 position = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`Any draw` = col_leg, Majority = "#e08214",
                               Unanimous = col_irr), name = "",
                    labels = vote_labs) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.04))) +
  labs(x = "Irreducible share", y = "Specifications") +
  theme_AP() +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.01, 0.86), legend.justification = c(0, 1))

hum_share <- fread(file.path(out, "human_validation_shares.csv"))
hum_top <- max(ggplot_build(plot_sob_a)$data[[1]]$count) * 1.08
plot_sob_a <- plot_sob_a +
  annotate("rect", xmin = min(hum_share$irreducible_share),
           xmax = max(hum_share$irreducible_share), ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "grey50", alpha = 0.18) +
  geom_point(data = hum_share, aes(x = irreducible_share, y = hum_top, shape = rater),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.1) +
  annotate("text", x = max(hum_share$irreducible_share) + 0.012, y = hum_top,
           label = "Human raters", size = 1.9, hjust = 0, colour = "grey25") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(anthropologist = 16, modeller_1 = 2,
                                modeller_2 = 0), guide = "none")

# Panel b: first- and total-order indices --------------------------------------

sob_long <- melt(sob_tot[, .(factor = fac_lab[factor], Si = si_first, Ti = ti)],
                 id.vars = "factor")

plot_sob_b <- ggplot(sob_long, aes(reorder(factor, value, max), value,
                                   fill = variable)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(0.6),
           colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2, width = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "",
                    values = c(Si = "#F8766D", Ti = "#00BFC4"),
                    labels = c(expression(S[italic(i)]),
                               expression(T[italic(i)]))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.04)),
                     breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 3)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Sobol' index") +
  theme_AP() +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.99, 0.03), legend.justification = c(1, 0),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"), legend.title = element_text(size = 6))

# Panel c: the ten second-order terms ------------------------------------------

sob_int <- sob_ind[order == 2]
sob_int[, lab := vapply(strsplit(term, ":", fixed = TRUE), function(p)
  paste(fac_lab[p], collapse = " : "), character(1))]

plot_sob_c <- ggplot(sob_int, aes(reorder(lab, si), si)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red",
             linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 2)) +
  labs(x = "", y = expression(S[ij])) +
  theme_AP() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5.6))
```

```{r fig1-shares-build, dependson="load-data"}
# FIGURE 1 PANELS #############################################################

draw_share <- merge(bin[, .(s_irr = mean(!legible)),
                        by = .(prompt, provider, id_cite)],
                    dt[, .(id_cite, site, domain_short, epistemic_type)],
                    by = "id_cite")
spec_grid <- CJ(vote = names(vote_rules), drop = c("none", unique(dt$site)),
                sorted = FALSE)
ensemble_by <- function(grp) {
  rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(spec_grid)), function(i) {
    sub <- draw_share[spec_grid$drop[i] == "none" | site != spec_grid$drop[i]]
    sub[, .(share = mean(s_irr >= vote_rules[[spec_grid$vote[i]]])),
        by = c(grp, "prompt", "provider")]
  }))
}

# Panel a: irreducible share by knowledge domain -------------------------------

dom_full <- ensemble_by("domain_short")

# Human raters ------------------------------------------------------------------

hum <- fread(file.path(out, "human_validation_ratings.csv"))[!is.na(irreducible)]
hum <- merge(hum, dt[, .(id_cite, domain_short, epistemic_type)], by = "id_cite")
hum_off <- 0
rater_shape <- scale_shape_manual(values = c(anthropologist = 16, modeller_1 = 2,
                                             modeller_2 = 0),
                                  labels = c("Anthropologist", "Modeller 1",
                                             "Modeller 2"),
                                  name = "Human rater")
dom_ens <- dom_full[, .(med = median(share), lo = min(share), hi = max(share)),
                    by = domain_short]
dom_ord <- dom_ens[order(-med), domain_short]
dom_full[, domain_short := factor(domain_short, levels = dom_ord)]
dom_ens[, domain_short := factor(domain_short, levels = dom_ord)]

plot_share_dom <- ggplot(dom_full, aes(domain_short, share)) +
  geom_violin(fill = col_irr, colour = NA, alpha = 0.35, scale = "width",
              width = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = dom_ens, aes(domain_short, med), size = 1.6,
             colour = col_irr) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.06))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) gsub(" & ", " &\n", x)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Irreducible share") +
  theme_AP()

hum_dom <- hum[, .(share = mean(irreducible)), by = .(domain_short, rater)]
hum_dom[, x := match(domain_short, dom_ord) + hum_off]
plot_share_dom <- plot_share_dom +
  geom_linerange(data = hum_dom[, .(lo = min(share), hi = max(share)), by = x],
                 aes(x = x, ymin = lo, ymax = hi), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(data = hum_dom, aes(x = x, y = share, shape = rater),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.1) +
  rater_shape +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
  labs(shape = "Human\nrater") +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.5, 0.02), legend.justification = c(0.5, 0),
        legend.title.position = "left",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 5.5, vjust = 0.5, lineheight = 0.9),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 5.2),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.25, "cm"),
        legend.key.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "cm"))

# Panel b: reducible share by form of knowledge --------------------------------

epi_labels <- c(heuristic_rule = "Heuristic rule",
                mechanistic_belief = "Mechanistic belief",
                valuation = "Valuation", indicator = "Indicator",
                astronomical = "Astronomical", calendrical = "Calendrical",
                normative_social = "Normative-social")
epi_full <- ensemble_by("epistemic_type")[, .(epistemic_type, red = 1 - share)]
epi_full <- merge(epi_full, dt[, .(n = .N), by = epistemic_type],
                  by = "epistemic_type")
epi_full[, label := sprintf("%s (%d)", epi_labels[epistemic_type], n)]
ep <- epi_full[, .(med = median(red), lo = min(red), hi = max(red),
                   at_zero = mean(red == 0)), by = label]
epi_ord <- ep[order(med), label]
epi_full[, label := factor(label, levels = epi_ord)]
ep[, label := factor(label, levels = epi_ord)]

plot_share_epi <- ggplot(epi_full, aes(red, label)) +
  geom_violin(fill = col_leg, colour = NA, alpha = 0.35, scale = "width",
              width = 0.8, trim = TRUE) +
  geom_point(data = ep, aes(med, label), size = 1.6, colour = col_leg) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(), breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 3),
                     limits = c(0, NA),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))) +
  labs(x = "Reducible share", y = "") +
  theme_AP()

hum_epi <- hum[, .(red = 1 - mean(irreducible)), by = .(epistemic_type, rater)]
hum_epi <- merge(hum_epi, unique(epi_full[, .(epistemic_type, label)]),
                 by = "epistemic_type")
hum_epi[, y := match(label, epi_ord) + hum_off]
plot_share_epi <- plot_share_epi +
  geom_linerange(data = hum_epi[, .(lo = min(red), hi = max(red)), by = y],
                 aes(y = y, xmin = lo, xmax = hi), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(data = hum_epi, aes(x = red, y = y, shape = rater),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.1) +
  rater_shape +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r fig1-panels-cd, dependson="fig1-shares-build"}
# FIGURE 2, PANELS C AND D ####################################################

# Panel c: the twelve-function vocabulary and how common each function is ------

fun_prev <- dt[, .(f = trimws(unlist(strsplit(functions, ";", fixed = TRUE)))),
               by = id_cite][f %in% names(fun_lab), .N, by = f]
fun_prev[, share := N / uniqueN(dt$id_cite)]
fun_prev[, label := factor(fun_lab[f], levels = fun_lab[fun_prev[order(share), f]])]

plot_share_fun <- ggplot(fun_prev, aes(share, label)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = share, yend = label), linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(size = 1.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = N), hjust = -0.5, size = 2, colour = "grey30") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(), limits = c(0, 0.97),
                     breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 3)) +
  labs(x = "Share of the corpus serving the function", y = "") +
  theme_AP()

# Panel d: reducibility against functions served outside the core --------------

dt[, n_noncore := vapply(strsplit(functions, ";", fixed = TRUE),
                         function(f) sum(!trimws(f) %in% core2), integer(1))]
dt[, ncat := fifelse(n_noncore >= 2L, "2 or more", as.character(n_noncore))]
draw_share[dt, on = "id_cite", ncat := i.ncat]
ncat_n <- dt[, .N, by = ncat]
ncat_labs <- c(`0` = "none", `1` = "one", `2 or more` = "two or more")
ncat_full <- ensemble_by("ncat")[, .(ncat, red = 1 - share)]
ncat_full[, label := factor(sprintf("%s\n(%d)", ncat_labs[ncat],
                                    ncat_n$N[match(ncat, ncat_n$ncat)]),
                            levels = sprintf("%s\n(%d)", ncat_labs,
                                             ncat_n$N[match(names(ncat_labs),
                                                            ncat_n$ncat)]))]
ncat_med <- ncat_full[, .(med = median(red)), by = label]

plot_share_ncat <- ggplot(ncat_full, aes(label, red)) +
  geom_violin(fill = col_leg, colour = NA, alpha = 0.35, scale = "width",
              width = 0.75, trim = TRUE) +
  geom_line(data = ncat_med, aes(label, med, group = 1), linewidth = 0.4,
            colour = col_leg) +
  geom_point(data = ncat_med, aes(label, med), size = 1.6, colour = col_leg) +
  geom_text(data = ncat_med, aes(label, med, label = percent(med, accuracy = 1)),
            vjust = -1.2, size = 2.2, colour = col_leg) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), limits = c(0, NA),
                     breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 4),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = "Functions served beyond\ncrop production and\nwater conservation",
       y = "Reducible share") +
  theme_AP()

hum_ncat <- merge(hum[, .(id_cite, rater, irreducible)], dt[, .(id_cite, ncat)],
                  by = "id_cite")[, .(red = 1 - mean(irreducible)), by = .(ncat, rater)]
hum_ncat[, x := match(ncat, names(ncat_labs)) + hum_off]
plot_share_ncat <- plot_share_ncat +
  geom_linerange(data = hum_ncat[, .(lo = min(red), hi = max(red)), by = x],
                 aes(x = x, ymin = lo, ymax = hi), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(data = hum_ncat, aes(x = x, y = red, shape = rater),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.1) +
  rater_shape +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

cat("Reducible share by number of functions outside the core:\n")
print(ncat_full[, .(median = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * median(red)),
                    range = sprintf("%.0f-%.0f%%", 100 * min(red),
                                    100 * max(red))), by = label])
```

```{r fig1-shares-panels, dependson="fig1-shares-build", fig.width=5.5, fig.height=1.8, fig.cap="The irreducible share by knowledge domain and by form of knowledge. Both panels summarise the 216 specifications that apply to a breakdown by group (three LLM families, three wordings of the removal-test rule, three vote rules, and keeping all communities or dropping one). The spread is specification uncertainty, not binomial sampling error. (a) Distribution of the irreducible share by knowledge domain: violins are scaled to equal width, points are medians. The distributions are skewed, with mass at 100\\% and a long lower tail, and irreducibility extends even to the domains closest to efficiency frameworks. Only the irreducible share is shown, the reducible share being its exact complement. (b) Distribution of the reducible share by form of knowledge (corpus counts in parentheses), violins scaled to equal width and points marking medians. Heuristic rules and mechanistic beliefs are partly absorbed. The remaining types return a reducible share of exactly zero in most specifications --- 97\\% for calendrical, 94\\% for astronomical, 76\\% for normative-social, 63\\% for valuation and 54\\% for indicator --- so their width near zero represents a spike rather than a spread, the share of a type with $n$ assumptions being restricted to multiples of $1/n$."}
# MAIN FIGURE 1 ##############################################################

fig1 <- plot_grid(plot_share_dom + 
                    labs(x = "Knowledge domain", y = "Irreducible \nshare"),
                  plot_share_epi + 
                    labs(x = "Reducible share", y = "Type of \nknowledge"), 
                  ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.45, 0.55),
          labels = c("a", "b"))
fig1
```

```{r numbers-results1, dependson="fig1-shares-build"}
# NUMBERS CITED IN RESULTS 1 ##################################################

hl <- fread(file.path(out, "sobol_headline_grid.csv"))
hi <- fread(file.path(out, "sobol_headline_indices.csv"))
cat(sprintf("Headline share over %d specifications: %.0f%%-%.0f%%, median %.0f%%\n",
            nrow(hl), 100 * min(hl$share), 100 * max(hl$share),
            100 * median(hl$share)))
cat(sprintf("Specifications above 80%%: %.0f%%\n", 100 * mean(hl$share >= 0.80)))

first <- hi[order == 1][order(-si)]
cat("\nFirst-order indices:\n")
print(first[, .(factor = term, Si = round(si, 3))])
cat("\nSecond-order terms above 0.02:\n")
print(hi[order == 2 & si > 0.02][order(-si), .(term, Sij = round(si, 3))])

# Grouped (closed) indices: what the corpus contains vs how it is read ---------

closed_index <- function(ind, group)
  ind[vapply(strsplit(term, ":", fixed = TRUE),
             function(p) all(p %in% group), logical(1)), sum(si)]
cc <- closed_index(hi, c("community", "domain"))
cr <- closed_index(hi, c("model", "prompt", "vote"))
cat(sprintf("\nCorpus composition %.3f | reading of the corpus %.3f | cross %.3f\n",
            cc, cr, 1 - cc - cr))

# Per-group medians quoted in the text ----------------------------------------

cat("\nIrreducible share by domain (median [range] across specifications):\n")
print(dom_ens[order(-med), .(domain_short, median = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * med),
                             range = sprintf("%.0f-%.0f%%", 100 * lo, 100 * hi))])
cat("\nReducible share by form of knowledge:\n")
print(ep[order(-med), .(label, median = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * med),
                        max = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * hi),
                        at_zero = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * at_zero))])

# The calendrical / astronomical claim, stated exactly -------------------------

cal <- ensemble_by("epistemic_type")[
  epistemic_type %in% c("calendrical", "astronomical")][, red := 1 - share]
cat(sprintf(paste0("\nCalendrical/astronomical: reducible in %.0f%% of the 216 ",
                   "specifications per type (max reducible share %.0f%%);\n",
                   "every affected specification uses %s.\n"),
            100 * mean(cal$red > 0), 100 * max(cal$red),
            paste(unique(cal[red > 0, sprintf("%s + %s rule", fam_lab[provider],
                                              prompt)]), collapse = ", ")))
```

# Results 2: no narrow framework captures most of it

```{r fig3-functions-build, dependson="load-data"}
# FIGURE 2 PANELS #############################################################

n_draws <- draws[, .(nd = uniqueN(draw)), by = .(family, phrasing, id_cite)]
counts <- merge(draws[, .(k = uniqueN(draw)),
                      by = .(family, phrasing, id_cite, f)],
                n_draws, by = c("family", "phrasing", "id_cite"))
counts <- merge(counts, dt[, .(id_cite, site, domain_short)], by = "id_cite")

fgrid <- CJ(community = c("none", unique(dt$site)),
            domain = c("none", unique(dt$domain_short)),
            family = families, phrasing = phrasings,
            vote = names(vote_rules), sorted = FALSE)

curves <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(fgrid)), function(i) {
  g <- fgrid[i]
  keep <- counts[family == g$family & phrasing == g$phrasing &
                   k / nd >= vote_rules[[g$vote]] &
                   (g$community == "none" | site != g$community) &
                   (g$domain == "none" | domain_short != g$domain)]
  if (!nrow(keep)) return(NULL)
  m <- dcast(unique(keep[, .(id_cite, f)]), id_cite ~ f,
             fun.aggregate = length, value.var = "f")
  mat <- as.matrix(m[, -1]); mat[mat > 0] <- 1
  s <- svd(mat)
  best <- vapply(seq_len(ncol(mat)), function(k) {
    a <- s$u[, 1:k, drop = FALSE] %*% diag(s$d[1:k], k, k) %*%
      t(s$v[, 1:k, drop = FALSE])
    mean(rowSums(((a >= 0.5) * 1) != mat) == 0)
  }, numeric(1))
  data.table(cell = i, phrasing = g$phrasing, k = seq_along(best), exact = best)
}))

env <- curves[, .(med = median(exact), lo = min(exact), hi = max(exact)), by = k]
k90 <- curves[exact >= 0.9, .(k90 = min(k)), by = cell]

# Panel a: the recovery envelope ------------------------------------------------

plot_fun_curve <- ggplot(env, aes(k, med)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.9, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey55",
             linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), fill = col_leg, alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, colour = col_leg) +
  geom_point(size = 1.1, colour = col_leg) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2, 12, 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Functions retained", y = "Assumptions recovered") +
  theme_AP()

# Panel b: how many functions are needed for 90% --------------------------------

plot_fun_k90 <- ggplot(k90, aes(factor(k90))) +
  geom_bar(fill = col_irr, width = 0.7) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.06))) +
  labs(x = "Functions needed to recover 90%", y = "Specifications") +
  theme_AP()

# Panel c: Sobol' indices for the two quantities --------------------------------

ft <- fread(file.path(out, "sobol_functions_totals.csv"))
ft <- ft[quantity %in% c("loss", "k90")]
ft[, `:=`(quantity = factor(quantity, levels = c("loss", "k90"),
                            labels = c("Compression loss",
                                       "Functions for 90%")),
          factor = c(community = "Community", domain = "Knowledge domain",
                     family = "LLM family", prompt = "Prompt",
                     phrasing = "Phrasing", vote = "Vote rule")[factor])]
ftl <- melt(ft[, .(quantity, factor, Si = si_first, Ti = ti)],
            id.vars = c("quantity", "factor"))

plot_fun_indices <- ggplot(ftl, aes(reorder(factor, value, max), value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(0.6), colour = "black",
           linewidth = 0.2, width = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ quantity, ncol = 1) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Sobol' indices",
                    values = c(Si = "#F8766D", Ti = "#00BFC4"),
                    labels = c(expression(S[italic(i)]), expression(T[italic(i)]))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.05)),
                     breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 3)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Sobol' index") +
  theme_AP() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5.8))
```

```{r figS7-frontier-build, dependson="fig3-functions-build"}
# THE COMPRESSION FRONTIER ####################################################

fr <- fread(file.path(out, "compression_frontier.csv"))

fr_env <- fr[, .(med = median(best_share), lo = min(best_share),
                 hi = max(best_share)), by = k][, bound := "Best choice of k functions"]
ce_env <- curves[, .(med = median(exact), lo = min(exact), hi = max(exact)),
                 by = k][, bound := "Best summary of any kind"]
env2 <- rbind(fr_env, ce_env)
env2[, bound := factor(bound, levels = c("Best summary of any kind",
                                         "Best choice of k functions"))]

core_med <- fr[k == 2, median(core_share)]
core_is_best <- fr[k == 2, mean(best_set == sum(2^(match(core2, funcs12) - 1)))]

plot_frontier <- ggplot(env2, aes(k, med, colour = bound, fill = bound)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.9, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey55",
             linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.18, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`Best summary of any kind` = "grey45",
                                 `Best choice of k functions` = col_leg),
                      name = "") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`Best summary of any kind` = "grey45",
                               `Best choice of k functions` = col_leg),
                    name = "") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2, 12, 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = bquote(italic(k) ~ "functions retained"), y = "Assumptions represented") +
  theme_AP() +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.98, 0.02), legend.justification = c(1, 0))

# Panel b: the order in which functions have to be added ----------------------

ord <- fr[, .(f = strsplit(best_names, "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]), by = .(cell, k)]
ord <- ord[, .(share = .N / uniqueN(fr$cell)), by = .(k, f)]
ord[, label := factor(fun_lab[f], levels = rev(fun_lab[c(core2,
      setdiff(names(sort(tapply(ord$share, ord$f, sum), decreasing = TRUE)), core2))]))]

plot_order <- ggplot(ord, aes(k, label, fill = share)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey92", high = col_irr, labels = percent_format(),
                      name = "", limits = c(0, 1), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2, 12, 2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = bquote(italic(k) ~ "functions retained"), y = "") +
  theme_AP() +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.key.width = unit(0.25, "cm"))

cat(sprintf("Best pair recovers %.0f%%; conventional pair %.0f%%; conventional pair is best in %.0f%% of cells\n",
            100 * fr[k == 2, median(best_share)], 100 * core_med, 100 * core_is_best))

An assumption counts as represented when every function it serves is recorded. Grey: the highest share reached by any optimal $k$-dimensional summary (for instance, an efficiency framework that blends functions by weighting soil health and biodiversity together). No representation with $k$ dimensions can do better than the grey shade. The lines denote the median across specifications and the bands show the full range. The dotted horizontal line marks 90%. b) Order in which functions enter the best efficiency framework as $k$ gets larger. # SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURE INPUTS #################################################

# Study sites --------------------------------------------------------------

locations <- data.table(
  place = c("Dúrcal", "Huétor-Tájar", "Murcia", "Ricote", "Sudanell",
            "Arriate", "Oria"),
  lon = c(-3.5694, -4.0439, -1.1307, -1.4361, 0.6011, -5.0606, -2.2731),
  lat = c(37.0022, 37.1964, 37.9922, 38.0714, 41.5261, 36.7914, 37.5225),
  n_interviews = c(12L, 13L, 39L, 6L, 11L, 10L, 18L))
stopifnot(sum(locations$n_interviews) == 109L)
spain <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", country = "Spain", returnclass = "sf")

# Label-free semantic witness ------------------------------------------------

emb <- fread(file.path(out, "emb_efficiency_distance.csv"))
lexm <- fread(file.path(out, "emb_projection_meta.csv"))
scree <- fread(file.path(out, "emb_scree.csv"))
summ <- fread(file.path(out, "emb_witness_summary.csv"))
meta_ids <- as.data.table(read_xlsx(here("datasets", "inputs",
                                         "assumption_list_updated.xlsx")))
setnames(meta_ids, tolower(names(meta_ids)))
demb <- merge(emb, meta_ids[, .(id = as.integer(our_id), id_cite)], by = "id")

lab_grid <- CJ(prompt = unique(bin$prompt), provider = unique(bin$provider),
               vote = names(vote_rules), sorted = FALSE)
consensus <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(lab_grid)), function(i) {
  g <- lab_grid[i]
  bin[prompt == g$prompt & provider == g$provider,
      .(irr = mean(!legible) >= vote_rules[[g$vote]]), by = id_cite]
}))[, .(share_irr = mean(irr)), by = id_cite]

demb <- merge(demb, consensus, by = "id_cite")
demb[, code := fifelse(share_irr > 0.5, "Irreducible", "Reducible")]

reducible <- demb$code == "Reducible"
auc_val <- local({
  r <- rank(demb$sim_centroid)
  (sum(r[reducible]) - sum(reducible) * (sum(reducible) + 1) / 2) /
    (sum(reducible) * sum(!reducible))
})
auc_spec <- fread(file.path(out, "embedding_auc.csv"))
auc_lab <- sprintf("AUC = %.2f\n[%.2f-%.2f]", median(auc_spec$auc),
                   min(auc_spec$auc), max(auc_spec$auc))
pc90 <- summ$pcs_for_90pct_variance
cat(sprintf("AUC %.2f | Wilcoxon p %.1e | %d of 384 components for 90%% variance\n",
            auc_val, wilcox.test(sim_centroid ~ code, data = demb)$p.value, pc90))
```

```{r dimensionality-build, dependson="fig3-functions-build"}
# DIMENSIONALITY OF THE CORPUS ################################################

cell_dim <- function(i) {
  g <- fgrid[i]
  keep <- counts[family == g$family & phrasing == g$phrasing &
                   k / nd >= vote_rules[[g$vote]] &
                   (g$community == "none" | site != g$community) &
                   (g$domain == "none" | domain_short != g$domain)]
  if (!nrow(keep)) return(NULL)
  m <- dcast(unique(keep[, .(id_cite, f)]), id_cite ~ f,
             fun.aggregate = length, value.var = "f")
  mat <- as.matrix(m[, -1]); mat[mat > 0] <- 1
  s <- svd(mat)
  p <- s$d^2 / sum(s$d^2)
  recover <- function(k) {
    a <- s$u[, 1:k, drop = FALSE] %*% diag(s$d[1:k], k, k) %*%
      t(s$v[, 1:k, drop = FALSE])
    rowSums(((a >= 0.5) * 1) != mat) == 0
  }
  ok2 <- recover(2)

  present_core <- intersect(core2, colnames(mat))
  nnon <- rowSums(mat[, setdiff(colnames(mat), core2), drop = FALSE])
  cls <- factor(fifelse(nnon >= 2L, "two or more", as.character(nnon)),
                levels = c("0", "1", "two or more"))
  cliff <- data.table(cell = i, nnon = cls, ok = ok2)[
    , .(n = .N, share = mean(ok)), by = .(cell, nnon)]

  core_mass <- if (length(present_core)) sum(s$v[match(present_core, colnames(mat)), 1]^2) else NA_real_

  list(scalar = data.table(cell = i, n_fun = ncol(mat),
                           pr = 1 / sum(p^2),
                           shannon = exp(-sum(p * log(p + 1e-300))),
                           k90_spec = which(cumsum(p) >= 0.90)[1],
                           pc1 = p[1], pc1_core_mass = core_mass,
                           r1 = mean(recover(1)), r2 = mean(ok2),
                           r4 = mean(recover(4))),
       cliff = cliff,
       spectrum = data.table(cell = i, pc = seq_along(p), cum_var = cumsum(p)))
}
dim_raw <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(fgrid)), cell_dim)
dim_raw <- dim_raw[!vapply(dim_raw, is.null, logical(1))]
dimen <- rbindlist(lapply(dim_raw, `[[`, "scalar"))
cliff <- rbindlist(lapply(dim_raw, `[[`, "cliff"))
spectrum <- rbindlist(lapply(dim_raw, `[[`, "spectrum"))
dimen <- merge(dimen, k90, by = "cell")

rng <- function(x, d = 2) sprintf("%.*f (%.*f--%.*f)", d, median(x), d, min(x), d, max(x))
cat("Over the 1,080 specifications of the function grid:\n\n")
cat(sprintf("  spectral rank, participation ratio : %s of twelve\n", rng(dimen$pr)))
cat(sprintf("  spectral rank, Shannon exp(H)      : %s of twelve\n", rng(dimen$shannon)))
cat(sprintf("  components for 90%% of the variance : %s\n", rng(dimen$k90_spec, 0)))
cat(sprintf("  variance in the first component    : %.0f%% (%.0f-%.0f%%)\n",
            100 * median(dimen$pc1), 100 * min(dimen$pc1), 100 * max(dimen$pc1)))
cat(sprintf("  SUPPORT rank, exact recovery of 90%%: %s\n", rng(dimen$k90, 0)))
cat(sprintf("\n  gap between support and spectral rank: %s dimensions\n",
            rng(dimen$k90 - dimen$k90_spec, 0)))
cat(sprintf("  support rank exceeds spectral rank in %.0f%% of specifications\n",
            100 * mean(dimen$k90 > dimen$k90_spec)))

# Ceilings on any metric of one, two or four dimensions -----------------------

cat("\nExact-recovery ceiling for the best possible metric of k dimensions:\n")
for (k in c("r1", "r2", "r4"))
  cat(sprintf("  k = %s : %.0f%% (%.0f-%.0f%%)\n", sub("r", "", k),
              100 * median(dimen[[k]]), 100 * min(dimen[[k]]), 100 * max(dimen[[k]])))

# The coding is itself a compression ------------------------------------------

emb_summary <- fread(file.path(out, "emb_witness_summary.csv"))
nuis <- fread(file.path(out, "embedding_nuisance.csv"))
emb_raw <- nuis[stage == "none (raw embedding)"]
cat(sprintf(paste0("\nLabel-free embedding of the same 475 assumptions (%d dimensions):\n",
                   "  participation ratio %.1f | Shannon exp(H) %.0f | %d components for 90%%\n"),
            emb_summary$dim, emb_raw$pr, emb_raw$shannon, emb_raw$k90))
cat(sprintf("  compression from embedding to coding: %.1f-fold in participation ratio\n",
            emb_raw$pr / median(dimen$pr)))

# Is that dimensionality linguistic rather than substantive? -------------------

cat("\nEffective dimensionality after removing nuisance variation from the embedding:\n")
print(nuis[, .(stage, removed = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * var_removed),
                pr = sprintf("%.1f", pr), k90)])

# Where the two-dimensional ceiling fails ------------------------------------

cat(sprintf(paste0("\nThe best two-dimensional summary is essentially the efficiency metric:\n",
                   "  share of the leading component sitting on crop production and\n",
                   "  water conservation: %.0f%% (%.0f-%.0f%%)\n"),
            100 * median(dimen$pc1_core_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
            100 * min(dimen$pc1_core_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
            100 * max(dimen$pc1_core_mass, na.rm = TRUE)))

cat("\nExact recovery at rank two, by functions served outside that pair:\n")
print(cliff[, .(assumptions = sprintf("%.0f (%.0f-%.0f)", median(n), min(n), max(n)),
                recovered = sprintf("%.0f%% (%.0f-%.0f%%)", 100 * median(share),
                                    100 * min(share), 100 * max(share))), by = nnon][order(nnon)])
cat(sprintf("\nSpecifications in which NO assumption serving two or more outside\nfunctions is recovered at rank two: %.0f%% of %d\n",
            100 * cliff[nnon == "two or more", mean(share == 0)],
            cliff[nnon == "two or more", .N]))
```

```{r figS5-dimensions, dependson=c("dimensionality-build","sm-build"), fig.width=5.6, fig.height=2.4, fig.cap="Comparison between the variance explained by a label-free sentence embedding model and the twelve-function coding approach. a) Cumulative share of variance against the number of principal components retained. The horizontal dotted line is at 90%; the lines show the median and the shade displays the full range across specifications. b) Participation ratio of each representation (the number of principal components that would carry its variance if they carried it equally). The dashed line marks twelve, the maximum the coding can take."}
# SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURE: EFFECTIVE DIMENSIONALITY ##############################

emb_pr <- emb_summary$participation_ratio
emb_k90 <- emb_summary$pcs_for_90pct_variance

cod_curve <- spectrum[, .(med = median(cum_var), lo = min(cum_var),
                          hi = max(cum_var)), by = pc]
cod_curve[, c("lo", "hi", "med") := lapply(.SD, pmin, 1), .SDcols = c("lo", "hi", "med")]  # cumsum rounding above 1

plot_spec <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.9, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey55",
             linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_ribbon(data = cod_curve, aes(pc, ymin = lo, ymax = hi), fill = col_irr,
              alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = cod_curve, aes(pc, med), colour = col_irr, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = scree[pc <= 80], aes(pc, cum_var), colour = col_leg,
            linewidth = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 14.5, y = 0.985, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.2,
           colour = col_irr, label = "twelve-function\ncoding", lineheight = 0.9) +
  annotate("text", x = 30, y = 0.56, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.2,
           colour = col_leg, label = "label-free\nembedding", lineheight = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Principal components retained", y = "Cumulative variance") +
  theme_AP()

pr_lab <- c(coding = "Twelve-function\ncoding", embedding = "Label-free\nembedding")
pr_dt <- data.table(what = factor(pr_lab[["coding"]], levels = rev(pr_lab)),
                    v = dimen$pr)
pr_point <- data.table(what = factor(c(pr_lab[["coding"]], pr_lab[["embedding"]]),
                                     levels = rev(pr_lab)),
                       v = c(median(dimen$pr), emb_pr))

plot_pr <- ggplot() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 12, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40",
             linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_violin(data = pr_dt, aes(v, what), fill = col_irr, colour = NA,
              alpha = 0.35, scale = "width", width = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = pr_point, aes(v, what),
             colour = c(col_leg, col_irr)[c(2, 1)], size = 1.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 36), breaks = seq(0, 36, 6)) +
  labs(x = "Effective dimensions (participation ratio)", y = "") +
  theme_AP() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))

cat(sprintf("embedding: participation ratio %.1f | %d of %d components for 90%%\n",
            emb_pr, emb_k90, emb_summary$dim))
cat(sprintf("coding:    participation ratio %.2f (%.2f-%.2f) over %d specifications\n",
            median(dimen$pr), min(dimen$pr), max(dimen$pr), nrow(dimen)))
cat(sprintf("ratio:     %.1f-fold\n", emb_pr / median(dimen$pr)))

plot_grid(plot_spec, plot_pr, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.5, 0.5), labels = "auto")
```

```{r figS8-sensory-build, dependson="load-data"}
# SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURE: SENSORY CHANNELS ######################################

sens <- fread(file.path(out, "sensory_practice_grid.csv"))
ch_lab <- c(visual = "Sight", tactile = "Touch", olfactory = "Smell",
            acoustic = "Hearing", gustatory = "Taste")

ch_col <- c(Sight = "#56B4E9", Touch = "#E69F00", Smell = "#009E73",
            Hearing = "#CC79A7", Taste = "#999999")

# Panel a: how many assumptions each channel carries ---------------------------

ch_tot <- sens[, .(n = sum(n)), by = .(cell, ch)][
  , .(med = as.numeric(median(n)), lo = min(n), hi = max(n)), by = ch]
ch_tot[, label := factor(ch_lab[ch], levels = ch_lab[ch_tot[order(med), ch]])]

plot_sens_tot <- ggplot(ch_tot, aes(med, label)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = lo, xend = hi, yend = label), colour = "grey65",
               linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = label), size = 1.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ch_col) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10", breaks = c(1, 3, 10, 30, 100, 300)) +
  labs(x = "Assumptions read through the channel", y = "") +
  theme_AP()

# Panel b: the sensory composition of each practice ----------------------------

comp <- sens[practice %in% names(prac_lab), .(n = sum(n)),
             by = .(cell, practice, ch)]
comp[, share := n / sum(n), by = .(cell, practice)]

comp <- merge(unique(comp[, .(cell, practice)])[, .(ch = names(ch_lab)),
                                                 by = .(cell, practice)],
              comp[, .(cell, practice, ch, share)],
              by = c("cell", "practice", "ch"), all.x = TRUE)
comp[is.na(share), share := 0]
comp <- comp[, .(share = median(share)), by = .(practice, ch)]
comp[, share := share / sum(share), by = practice]
comp[, channel := factor(ch_lab[ch], levels = ch_lab)]
tac_ord <- comp[ch == "tactile"][order(share), practice]
comp[, label := factor(prac_lab[practice], levels = prac_lab[tac_ord])]

plot_sens_prac <- ggplot(comp, aes(share, label, fill = channel)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ch_col, name = "") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(),
                     expand = expansion(c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = "Share of the channel readings of each practice", y = "") +
  theme_AP() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6), legend.position = "right",
        legend.key.width = unit(0.25, "cm"))

cat("Sensory composition of each practice (median share across specifications):\n")
print(dcast(comp, label ~ channel, value.var = "share",
            fun.aggregate = function(z) round(100 * sum(z))))
```

```{r figS8-sensory, dependson="figS8-sensory-build", fig.width=6, fig.height=2.1, fig.cap="Sensory channels through which irrigators read their environment across the $1{,}080$ analytical specifications. a) Number of assumptions read through each channel. Points denote medians across specifications and bars denote the full range. b) Sensory composition of each practice (median share across analytical specifications). ``Taste'' has a zero median share because it is present in less than half of the specifications. This is why it does not appear in the stacked barplot."}
# SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURE: SENSORY CHANNELS ######################################

plot_grid(plot_sens_tot, plot_sens_prac, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.38, 0.62),
          labels = "auto")
